title: Independence of coordinate indicators
statement: Let $p$ be a nonnegative real number with $p\le 1$, and let $k$ be a natural number. Under the product measure on Boolean strings of length $k$ whose coordinates are independent Bernoulli variables with parameter $p$, the coordinate indicator random variables are mutually independent.
